title: Cross-Lingual Probing and Community-Grounded Analysis of Gender Bias in Low-Resource Bengali

bias_targets.methodology: The study extracts and evaluates gender-biased utterances in Bengali using six complementary approaches: cross-lingual retrieval (LaBSE mining) using biased English seed sentences, translation-based transfer from existing English/Chinese gender bias corpora (BUG and CORGI-PM), computational binary classification (fine-tuned mBERT), continuous bias scoring, lexicon-based heuristic mining (comparing word embeddings of adjectives to Bengali words for 'man' and 'woman'), and prompt-driven generation using GPT.
